keywords: EIP-8261 gas limit 改由硬分叉排期
summary: misilva73 提交 EIP-2780 重写，把 21,000 的基础成本拆成按资源计价的原语。barnabasbusa 提交 EIP-8261，让区块 gas limit 只能在硬分叉时调整，取消验证者配置和 EIP-1559 的弹性调整。pedrouid 提交 EIP-8141 扩展特性集，想把 frame 交易扩成完整的原生 AA 升级。EF 博客发布 Protocol 团队五月更新。

items.title: EIP-2780：改写为按资源计价的交易内在 gas
items.note: （misilva73）提交。总数不变，标准转账的 21,000 由 `TX_BASE_COST + COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS + TX_VALUE_COST + TRANSFER_LOG_COST` 组成，每一项对应交易实际消耗的资源。
items.title_en: EIP-2780: rework as resource-based intrinsic transaction gas
items.note_en: (misilva73), submitted. The total is unchanged: a standard transfer's 21,000 is `TX_BASE_COST + COLD_ACCOUNT_ACCESS + TX_VALUE_COST + TRANSFER_LOG_COST`, each priced to the resource the transaction actually consumes.

items.title: 新 EIP：Gas Limit Schedule
items.note: （barnabasbusa）提交，即 EIP-8261；EIP-8261 讨论帖 22:02。区块 gas_limit 变成由硬分叉排期、共识强制的参数，取消客户端参数和验证者偏好设置，也取消 EIP-1559 的 ±1/1024 弹性规则；仿照 EIP-7892 的 BPO 分叉引入只改 gas 参数的 gpo 分叉。
items.note_en: (barnabasbusa), submitted as EIP-8261; EIP-8261 discussion thread, 22:02. The block gas_limit becomes a hard-fork-scheduled, consensus-enforced parameter, removing client flags and validator preferences as well as the EIP-1559 ±1/1024 elasticity rule; "gas parameter only" (gpo) forks are modeled on the BPO forks of EIP-7892.

items.title: EIP-8261 讨论帖
items.note: 新 EIP：Gas Limit Schedule（barnabasbusa）提交，即 EIP-8261；EIP-8261 讨论帖 22:02。区块 gas_limit 变成由硬分叉排期、共识强制的参数，取消客户端参数和验证者偏好设置，也取消 EIP-1559 的 ±1/1024 弹性规则；仿照 EIP-7892 的 BPO 分叉引入只改 gas 参数的 gpo 分叉。
items.note_en: New EIP: Gas Limit Schedule (barnabasbusa), submitted as EIP-8261; EIP-8261 discussion thread, 22:02. The block gas_limit becomes a hard-fork-scheduled, consensus-enforced parameter, removing client flags and validator preferences as well as the EIP-1559 ±1/1024 elasticity rule; "gas parameter only" (gpo) forks are modeled on the BPO forks of EIP-7892.

items.title: EIP-8141：扩展特性集
items.note: （pedrouid）提交，提议把 guarantor（让发送方验证可能失败的交易也能进入公共内存池的付款方原语，可安全支持 ERC-20 paymaster 还款）、灵活 nonce 等下游功能并入，把 EIP-8141 从一个新交易类型扩展成完整的原生 AA 升级。
items.note_en: (pedrouid), submitted, proposing to fold in downstream features such as guarantors (a payer primitive that makes transactions admissible to the public mempool even when sender validation may fail, enabling safe ERC-20 paymaster repayment) and flexible nonces, turning EIP-8141 from a new transaction type into a complete native AA upgrade.

summary_en: misilva73 submitted an EIP-2780 rewrite that rebuilds the 21,000 base cost from primitives priced by resource. barnabasbusa submitted EIP-8261, which lets the block gas limit change only at hard forks and removes validator configuration and EIP-1559 elasticity. pedrouid submitted an extended feature set for EIP-8141 that aims to turn frame transactions into a complete native AA upgrade. The EF blog published the Protocol team's May update.
